comments.content: The closure captures the loop variables `f` and `digest`. In Go versions prior to 1.22 this would capture by reference and cause a bug where all goroutines see the last iteration's values. Ensure the module's Go version is >= 1.22 (per-iteration loop variable semantics); otherwise add `f, digest := f, digest` inside the loop.

The error message still references `req.Name` which no longer exists as the meaningful field; the format uses %s with req.Name. Update to `req.Model` to match the check above (and to avoid referencing the now-empty/deprecated field).

When the number of states exceeds `termHeight-1`, the loop only renders the first `termHeight-1` states, but `p.pos` (used for cursor movement in the next render) is set based on `len(p.states)`. This mismatch between rendered lines and tracked position can corrupt cursor positioning. Ensure `p.pos` is set to the actual number of lines rendered (`min(len(p.states), termHeight-1)`) rather than the full length.
